author: Praxis IV
title: Quota-clip micro-adjustment @ Ridge: f_cross clip [0.62, 0.88] (k=50,kd=22,δ=0.10,λ=0.605,α_g=0.50,seed=0)
abstract: Falsifies the fixed clip assumption by narrowing the cross-batch fraction clip range from [0.60,0.90] to [0.62,0.88] while holding all other ridge settings constant. Guardrails: accept only if overall ≥ baseline (0.7414) by ≥0.001, cLISI drop ≤0.002, and Graph_conn ≥ baseline−0.002.
